cards.text:
艾露西亚·范雯 APL 移动豁免耐伤
3 6" 4+ 8
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
家传圣物手枪 4 3+ 4/5 范围 8"、关键穿刺 1、集中、追踪轻型
单分子杖剑 4 3+ 3/6 致命 5+
干扰立场：每当一名特工向这名特工执行射击时，
忽视它的“穿刺”武器规则。
微型激光：每当这名特工执行近战行动时，在掷攻
击骰子步骤开始时，您可以使用这个规则。若此，
在那次流程中敌方特工受到 1 点伤害。
冷酷：每当这名特工对行动开始时已经受伤的一名
敌方特工执行射击，近战或反击时，这名特工的武
器获得“平衡”武器规则；若其武器已经有了那个
武器规则，则会获得“无休”武器规则而不是“平
衡”武器规则。
维护声誉：当这名特工在战斗中首次残废一名敌方
特工时，您可以获得额外 1 点 CP 或者额外使用一
次贸易许可规则（将至多使用三次替换为至多使用
四次）。请注意，您依然在每场战斗中不能使用同
一个贸易许可规则超过一次。
艾露西亚星行者、帝国、队长、艾露西亚·范雯 25
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
ELUCIA VHANE
3 6" 4+ 8
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Heirloom relic pistol 4 3+ 4/5 Range 8", Piercing Crits 1, Seek Light
Monomolecular cane-rapier 4 3+ 3/6 Lethal 5+
Digital Lasers: Whenever this operative performs the Fight
action, at the start of the Roll Attack Dice step, you can use
this rule. If you do, inflict 1 damage on the enemy operative in
that sequence.
Merciless: Whenever this operative is shooting against, fighting
against or retaliating against an enemy operative that was
already wounded when the action started, this operative's
weapons have the Balanced weapon rule; if the weapon already
has that weapon rule, it has the Ceaseless weapon rule instead
of Balanced.
Disruption Field: Whenever an operative is shooting this
operative, ignore the Piercing weapon rule.
Reputation to Maintain: The first time this operative
incapacitates an enemy operative during the battle, you can
either gain 1 additional CP or use an additional WARRANT OF
TRADE rule (up to four uses per battle, instead of three). Note
that you still cannot use the same WARRANT OF TRADE rule
more than once per battle.
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER , IMPERIUM, LEADER, ELUCIA VHANE 25

2 8" 5+ 7

恶毒撕咬 4 3+ 3/4 撕裂
猛兽：这名特工无法执行除冲锋，冲刺，后撤，近
战，捡回，戒备，转移，拾取标识和放置标识外
的任何行动，并无法使用任何其数据卡上没有的
武器。
忠诚伙伴：每当一名敌方特工执行近战行动时，若
这名特工为执行近战的有效目标，您便可以迫使它
们选择这名特工执行近战作为替代。每当一名敌方
特工在这名特工 3" 内的另一名艾露西亚星行者特
工控制范围内结束冲锋行动，如果这名特工不位于
敌方特工的控制范围内，这名特工便可以立即执行
一个无消耗的冲锋行动，但那次移动必须在那名敌
方特工控制范围内结束。
捡回 1AP
使用这名特工执行一次无消耗的冲刺或转移行
动。在那次移动中，这名特工可以执行一次无消
耗的拾取标识或放置标识行动（你可以为此在那
个行动中进行控制目标），并在之后继续使用冲
刺或转移行动的移动距离。
艾露西亚星行者、帝国、猎犬 25
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
CANID
2 8" 5+ 7
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Vicious bite 4 3+ 3/4 Rending
Beast: This operative cannot perform any actions other than
Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight, Gather, Guard,
Reposition, Pick Up Marker and Place Marker. It
cannot use any weapons that aren’t on its datacard.
Loyal Companion: Whenever an enemy operative performs
the Fight action, if this operative is a valid operative to fight
against, you can force them to select this operative to fight
against instead. Whenever an enemy operative ends the Charge
action within control range of another friendly ELUCIDIAN
STARSTRIDER operative within 3" of this operative, if this
operative isn’t within control range of enemy operatives, this
operative can immediately perform a free Charge action, but
must end that move within control range of that enemy operative.
GATHER 1AP
Perform a free Dash or Reposition action with this
operative. During that move, it can perform a free Pick
Up Marker or Place Marker action (you can determine
control during that action to do so), and any remaining move
distance it had from the Dash or Reposition action can be
used after it does so.
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER , IMPERIUM, CANID 25

cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
REJUVENAT ADEPT
2 6" 4+ 8
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Laspistol 4 4+ 2/3 Range 8"
Scalpel claw 3 4+ 3/4 Rending
Medic!: The first time during each turning point that another
friendly ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER operative would be
incapacitated while visible to and within 3" of this operative,
you can use this rule, providing neither this nor that operative
is within control range of an enemy operative. If you do, that
friendly operative isn’t incapacitated, has 3 wounds remaining
and cannot be incapacitated for the remainder of the action.
After that action, that friendly operative can immediately
perform a free Dash action, but must end that move within
this operative’s control range. If this rule was used during that
friendly operative’s activation, that activation ends. You cannot
use this rule if this operative is incapacitated, or if it’s a Shoot
action and this operative would be a primary or secondary target.
Normaliser Helm: Whenever a friendly ELUCIDIAN
STARSTRIDER operative is within 6" of this operative, you
can ignore any changes to that operative’s stats from being
injured (including its weapons’ stats).
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER , IMPERIUM, MEDIC, REJUVENAT ADEPT 25

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
阵营规则
贸易许可
行商的许可证能使他们在帝国中获得难以想
象的通行权。他们比起其他帝国特工更为圆
滑——交易，恐吓或是“借用”是他们在获
取宝贵资源或是进行任意其他交易时占据上
风的惯用手段。
在每场战斗中，您可以使用贸易许可规则至多四
次（见下文）。每个规则都各自描述了其使用的
时机，并且您无法在每场战斗中多次使用同一个
技能。
斟酌
时机：在选择特工阶段，揭示己方装备选项后。
效果：选择一个额外的装备选项，但不能选择先
前已经选择过的选项。
请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
FACTION RULE
WARRANT OF TRADE
The writ of a Rogue Trader allows them incredible
access across the Imperium. With more flexibility than
almost any other agents of the Imperium, they barter,
intimidate and 'borrow' to gain valuable resources
that allow them to enter any engagement with the
upper hand.
Up to four times per battle, you can use a
WARRANT OF TRADE rule (below). Each one
specifies when it can be used, and you cannot
use the same WARRANT OF TRADE rule more
than once per battle.
Consideration
When: In the Select Operatives step, after
revealing your equipment options.
Effect: Select one additional equipment option. It
cannot be an option you have previously selected.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
协调
时机：在选择特工步骤结束时。
效果：您获得额外 1 点 CP。
胁迫
时机：在部署特工步骤开始时。
效果：您的对手必须在己方部署任何特工前部署
自己的所有特工。此外，选择下列选项之一：
• 您的对手必须在己方部署任何装备前先部署自
己的所有装备。
• 己方可以在您的对手部署任何装备前先部署自
己的所有装备。
探索
时机：在第一个转折点中使用战略计划时。
效果：完全位于己方降落区的 D3 名己方艾露
西亚星行者特工可以执行一次无消耗的转移行
动，每一名这样的特工必须在移动结束时完全位
于己方降落区 4" 内。
请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
Coordinate
When: At the end of the Select Operatives step.
Effect: You gain 1 additional CP.
Coerce
When: At the start of the Set Up Operatives step.
Effect: Your opponent must set up all of their
operatives before you set up any. Additionally,
select one of the following options:
• Your opponent must set up all of their
equipment before you set up any.
• You can set up all of your equipment before
your opponent sets up any.
Explore
When: STRATEGIC GAMBIT in the first
turning point.
Effect: Perform a free Reposition action with D3
friendly ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER operatives
that are wholly within your drop zone. Each that
does so must end that move wholly within 4" of
your drop zone.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
收买
时机：在您应当激活一名特工时。
效果：您可以跳过那次激活。
争取
时机：在战略阶段，为决定先手权进行掷骰后。
效果：您可以重掷您的骰子。
灵活条款（仅限认证行动）
时机：第二个转折点结束时。
效果：选择一个新的战术行动或一个新的主要行
动。如果您选择了一个新的战术行动，任何先前
从战术行动中获得的点数将被弃置。
cards.text_en:
Bribe
When: It’s your turn to activate an operative.
Effect: You can skip that activation.
Seize
When: In the Strategy phase, after rolling off to
decide initiative.
Effect: You can re-roll your dice.
Adaptable Terms (Approved Ops only)
When: At the end of the second turning point.
Effect: Select a new tac op or a new primary op.
If you select a new tac op, any points scored from
the previous tac op are discarded.

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
阵营规则
私掠者支援资产
星行者们从不远离“新黎明号”。通过头顶
的宏伟舰载炮阵，这些宝贵的空中支援如雨
点般倾泻在敌人之上，吓退了无数海盗，异
形以及调查过深的官员，并能在交涉中实施
炮舰外交这一手段的字面含义。
每个交战阶段限一次，当一名己方艾露西亚星行
者海军或艾露西亚星行者艾露西亚·范雯特
工执行射击行动时，您可以选择使用下列私掠者
支援资产之一的远程武器。每种私掠者支援资产
在每场战斗中不能使用超过一次。
每当一名己方艾露西亚星行者特工使用私掠者
支援资产时，确定掩护豁免的方法与常规情况不
同。作为替代，当目标底盘的任意部分位于制高
点地形下时，它便获得掩护豁免。请注意尽管这
会影响目标的掩护豁免，但您依然需要按照正常
方式选择有效目标。换言之，这种射击是由一名
杀戮区内的特工进行引导后自上方而来。
请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
FACTION RULE
PRIVATEER SUPPORT ASSETS
The Starstriders never stray too far from the New Dawn.
Overhead, its massive batteries of ship-based artillery
rain down on enemies, providing invaluable air support.
Once per Firefight phase, when a friendly
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER NAVIS or ELUCIDIAN
STARSTRIDER ELUCIA VHANE operative
performs the Shoot action, you can select one
of the following PRIVATEER SUPPORT ASSET
ranged weapons for it to use. You cannot use
each PRIVATEER SUPPORT ASSET more than
once per battle.
Whenever a friendly ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
operative is using a PRIVATEER SUPPORT ASSET,
determine cover saves differently. Instead, the
target has a cover save if any part of its base is
underneath Vantage terrain. Note that while this
can affect the target’s cover save, you must still
select a valid target as normal. In other words, the
shot is guided by an operative in the killzone, but
it comes from above.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
战略计谋
致命距离
这些饱经跳帮战斗和狭窄空间战斗训练的星行
者们在近距离交火中极为老练。
每当一名己方艾露西亚星行者特工对位于它 6"
内的一名特工射击时，那名己方特工的远程武
器（私掠者支援资产除外）获得“平衡”武器
规则。
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
STRATEGY PLOY
LETHAL PROXIMITY
Well-drilled in boarding actions and combat in cramped
conditions, the Starstriders truly excel in close-
quarters firefights.
Whenever a friendly ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
operative is shooting an operative within 6" of
it, that friendly operative's ranged weapons
(excluding PRIVATEER SUPPORT ASSET
weapons) have the Balanced weapon rule.

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
战略计谋
权益声明
当艾露西亚·范雯对某个战利品宣称权利时，
星行者们会奋力确保将其送至她手。
将一枚己方声明标识放置在杀戮区中。当一名己
方艾露西亚星行者特工对位于那枚标识 3" 内的
敌方特工执行射击，近战或进行反击时，在掷攻
击骰步骤中，您可以将一枚己方失败的骰子保留
为普通成功而非将其弃置，或者将一枚己方普通
成功保留为一枚关键成功。在转折点结束时，将
己方声明标识从杀戮区移除。
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
STRATEGY PLOY
STAKE CLAIM
When Elucia Vhane stakes her claim upon a prize, the
Starstriders will strive to ensure it is delivered into
her hands.
Place your Claim marker in the killzone.
Whenever a friendly ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
operative is shooting against, fighting against
or retaliating against an enemy operative that’s
within 3" of that marker, in the Roll Attack Dice
step, you can retain one of your fails as a normal
success instead of discarding it, or retain one
of your normal successes as a critical success
instead. At the end of the turning point, remove
your Claim marker from the killzone.

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
战略计谋
无畏探险家
星行者们在穿越虚空的旅途中饱经无数风雨，
能够忍受那些足以使一般士兵却步的伤势。
在本转折点中，每一名特工在结算攻击骰子步骤
中首次因为一枚攻击骰子受到伤害时，您可以
将受到的伤害减半（向上取整，且至多降低至 2
点）。
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
STRATEGY PLOY
UNDAUNTED EXPLORERS
The Starstriders have weathered many terrible storms
in their journeys through the void, and are capable of
shrugging off wounds that would fell lesser soldiers.
The first time an attack dice inflicts damage
on each friendly ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
operative during the turning point in the Resolve
Attack Dice step, you can halve that inflicted
damage (rounding up, to a minimum of 2).

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
战略计谋
迅捷行军
艾露西亚星行者就如同那些精锐星界军一般
无所畏惧，能以极快的推进速度包抄甚至包
围敌人。
每当一名己方艾露西亚星行者特工在它的激活
中执行了转移行动，您便可以使用这个规则。若
此，直到那次激活结束前，为它的移动属性增
加 1"，但它在那次移动结束时必须更为靠近您对
手的降落区，且不能在那次激活中使用私掠者支
援资产。
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
STRATEGY PLOY
QUICK MARCH
As fearless as any elite Astra Militarum regiment, the
Elucidian Starstriders advance swiftly to outflank and
isolate their enemies.
Whenever a friendly ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
operative performs the Reposition action
during its activation, you can use this rule. If
you do, add 1" to its Move stat until the end
of that activation, but it must end that move
closer to your opponent’s drop zone and cannot
use a PRIVATEER SUPPORT ASSET during
that activation.

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
交战计谋
联合攻击
帝国海军的标准训练使得星行者们能通过迅猛
的齐射向敌人倾泻怒火。只要数量足够，即便
是普通的激光枪也足以击溃坚固的防御。
当一名己方艾露西亚星行者特工在执行射击的
掷攻击骰子后使用本交战计谋。如果目标在这个
转折点中被其他己方艾露西亚星行者特工射击
过，您便可以重掷任意己方攻击骰子。您不能在
使用私掠者支援资产执行射击时使用这个计谋。
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
COMBINED ARMS
The standard training of the Navis Imperialis allows the
Starstriders to rain fury down upon the enemy with rapid
volleys. In great enough volume, even the humble lasgun
can shatter formidable defences.
Use this firefight ploy after rolling your attack
dice for a friendly ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
operative, if it’s shooting an enemy operative
that’s been shot by another friendly ELUCIDIAN
STARSTRIDER operative during this turning
point. You can re-roll any of your attack dice.
You cannot use this ploy while shooting with a
PRIVATEER SUPPORT ASSET.

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
交战计谋
求生专家
在躲入掩体的短暂空隙中，星行者们会包扎伤
口，并使用兴奋药剂，做好再次交战的准备。
当一名己方艾露西亚星行者特工激活时使用本
交战计谋。那名己方特工恢复 D3+2 点失去的耐
伤，并且在那次激活中可以忽视对它 APL 属性
的任何修正。
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
SURVIVALIST
Ducking into cover for a brief moment, the Starstrider
bandages their wounds, applies stimms and prepares to
rejoin the fight.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly ELUCIDIAN
STARSTRIDER operative is activated. That
friendly operative regains up to D3+2 lost wounds
and during that activation you can ignore any
changes to its APL stat.

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
交战计谋
饱经考验
每一位派遣至行商的帝国海军船兵都是精挑细
选的精英，已经准备好面对甚至超越自己的职
责所在。
当一名己方艾露西亚星行者海军特工激活时使
用本交战计谋。在那次激活结束前，为它的 APL
属性增加 1 点。
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
GREAT ENDURANCE
Each member of the Navis Imperialis assigned to a
Rogue Trader is elite and prepared to endure the most
testing of circumstances to perform their duties.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly ELUCIDIAN
STARSTRIDER NAVIS operative’s activation.
Until the end of the activation, add 1 to its
APL stat.

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
交战计谋
训练有素
通过频繁且激烈的磨练跳帮技艺，帝国海军的
成员们精于协同突袭，共同完成任务目标。
当一名己方艾露西亚星行者海军特工激活时使
用本交战计谋。选择位于那名特工 3" 内其且可
见且就绪的另一名己方艾露西亚星行者海军特
工。当那个第一名特工进入待机，您便可以在您
对手进行激活前激活那个另一名己方特工。
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
WELL-DRILLED
Trained regularly and vigorously in the art of boarding
actions, members of the Navis Imperialis are expected
to precisely coordinate their strikes, working in tandem
to complete the goals of the mission at hand.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly ELUCIDIAN
STARSTRIDER NAVIS operative is activated.
Select one other ready friendly ELUCIDIAN
STARSTRIDER NAVIS operative visible to and
within 3" of that operative. When that first friendly
operative is expended, you can activate that other
friendly operative before your opponent activates.
When that other operative is expended, your
opponent then activates as normal.

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
阵营装备
装甲内衬
通过向海军制服内织入烧蚀护甲甲片和钢质加
强筋，他们获得了额外的防护。
每当一名特工向豁免属性为 5+ 的一名己方艾露
西亚星行者特工（猎犬除外）执行射击时，您
可以将己方防御骰子中一枚结果为 4 的骰子保留
为普通成功。
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
ARMOURED UNDERSUIT
Ablative plates and steel reinforcements are woven
into naval fatigues, providing an additional layer
of protection.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER operative (excluding
CANID) that has a 5+ Save stat, you can retain
one of your defence dice results of 4 as a
normal success.

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
阵营装备
高能电容包
通过对激光枪和激光手枪进行危险但致命的改
装，星行者们的杀伤力得到了进一步提升——
尽管这要冒上负伤的风险。
每个转折点至多两次，每当一名己方艾露西亚星
行者特工执行射击行动并选择了激光手枪、激
光枪或圣物激光手枪时，您便可以使用本规则。
若此，直到那个转折点结束前，为那个武器的两
个伤害属性各自增加 1 点，并获得“过热”和“
关键穿刺 1 ”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
HOT SHOT CAPACITOR PACKS
Dangerous but lethal modification of lasguns and
laspistols provide the Starstriders with additional killing
power, albeit with the risk of injury.
Up to twice per turning point, whenever a
friendly ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER operative
is performing the Shoot action and you select a
laspistol, lasgun or relic laspistol, you can use this
rule. If you do, until the end of the turning point,
add 1 to both Dmg stats of that weapon and it has
the Hot and Piercing Crits 1 weapon rules.

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
阵营装备
改良型坐标链路
帝国海军特工们使用的三角定位装置能使“新
黎明号”的武器阵列更为精准地瞄准敌人。
每当一名己方艾露西亚星行者特工使用私掠者
支援资产执行射击行动时，若目标位于一名己方
艾露西亚星行者海军特工 6" 内时，目标无法被
遮挡且那个武器获得“集中”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
IMPROVED COORDINATES UPLINK
Coordinated triangulation undertaken by Navis
Imperialis operatives allows the New Dawn’s weapon
batteries to more accurately target the foe.
Whenever a friendly ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
operative is using a PRIVATEER SUPPORT ASSET,
if the target is within 6" of a friendly ELUCIDIAN
STARSTRIDER NAVIS operative, the target
cannot be obscured and that weapon has the
Saturate weapon rule.

cards.text:
艾露西亚星行者
阵营装备
速射炮阵
“新黎明号”宏伟的武器阵列充能和装填都较
为缓慢。只有那些精英炮兵班组拥有快速齐射
的技艺和协调能力。
每场战斗限一次，在选择私掠者支援资产时，您
可以选择一个在这场战斗中已经使用过的选项。
这个规则优先于普通私掠者支援资产规则。
cards.text_en:
ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
RAPID GUNNERY
The New Dawn’s colossal batteries are slow to reload
and recharge. Only veteran gun crews possess the
expertise and coordination to fire a rapid salvo.
Once per battle, when selecting a PRIVATEER
SUPPORT ASSET, you can select one that's
already been used during the battle. This
takes precedence over the normal PRIVATEER
SUPPORT ASSET rules.
